description: This file implements a React component for a Tic Tac Toe game with a UI rendered on a webpage. It manages game state, user interactions, and display elements, including score tracking and game logic.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner in the current board state by checking predefined winning line combinations.

methods.name: formatPlayerWithIcon
methods.description: Formats a player representation with an associated Unicode icon for accessibility and status display.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on a cell; updates the board state if the cell is empty and the game is ongoing.

methods.name: softReset
methods.description: Resets the game board to initial state while preserving scores.

methods.name: hardReset
methods.description: Resets the game including scores and board state.
